verdict.rationale: Cursor documents some exports of its own data in open formats. These include OpenTelemetry export of team usage data, JSON/CSV endpoints for AI code-tracking metrics, and standard git push/pull for repos hosted on Origin. Nothing in the evidence shows a user-facing 'export all my data' path covering chat and agent history, settings, or account data. Missing for 10: comprehensive personal data export (conversations, agent sessions, settings), documented account deletion or exit path, export available outside Enterprise plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
